onsite_generation: None proposed for primary supply; screening-stage description included emergency backup gas generation via a mains gas connection, while June 2026 reporting states no diesel backup generators are proposed
demand_flexibility: Developer markets the project as absorbing frequently curtailed local wind generation, but no flexibility mechanism, private wire or PPA has been evidenced
notes: 'Powered entirely by renewable energy' / 'principally powered through local renewable energy' are developer claims with no stated matching method; 225 MW is the developer's full-capacity consumption figure, recorded here as peak load for want of a stated basis. No annual energy figure published.
